metadata.name: OpenBEXI Timeline
metadata.description: Users create, update and delete models and filters. Model contains presentation structures and namespaces, connects to sources containing records, and uses shared rendering.
metadata.purpose: Represent all observed fields in the local Timeline model files, with exact source mappings and the requested User, Model and Filter concepts.
modelingNotes: Class names are nouns. User is a root class with role as an attribute; creates, updates and deletes are separate relationships to Model and Filter.
Model and Source are hyperclasses that visually contain their configuration concepts. Original JSON nesting and types are recorded by sourceBindings and fieldCoverage.
Model summary attributes project parameter and connected presentation fields. Model.color represents timeline or preset backgroundColor; Band.color remains the individual band color.
Filter.regex maps to filter_value and preserves the legacy include|exclude expression. Source Rule.include/exclude and Band Condition.field/equals have separate meanings.
The configuration envelope is retained as metadata. The supplied example keeps its original keys and values; canonical HBDS names are mapped to those original paths.
Coverage records observed fields and types, not mandatory schema requirements. Wildcard JSON Pointer patterns use * for array elements and RFC 6901 escaping for property names.

Record belongs to Source; Namespace belongs to Model. Render is a root class. One Model uses Render link applies recursively to all Model descendants; local settings override inherited values. This is Timeline configuration, independent of HBDS diagram styling and class inheritance.

sourceScan.contentBasis: Local working-tree bytes, including files excluded by ignore rules.
